title: A dimension and its units
description: One file per dimension, units/<key>.json: the dimension, the unit its conversions lead to, and its units in each system (PRD 03 §9: metric by default, imperial available for length, area, mass, temperature and volume). A quantity is stored in one unit and shown in the household's system through the unit's counterpart.

key.description: The dimension's key, and the file's name: the record's key, the one field without a source.

base_unit.description: The key of the unit every other unit of the dimension converts to. Its own conversion is the identity.

key.description: The unit's key, unique across every dimension: the record's key, the one field without a source.

symbol.description: The unit's symbol, the same in every language.

cldr.description: The unit's Unicode CLDR identifier, which ICU formats a quantity in (Intl.NumberFormat's unit style, where the platform supports the unit).

to_base.description: The exact conversion to the dimension's base unit: base = (value + offset) × numerator ÷ denominator. A fraction where the factor has no finite decimal, as 5/9 for °F.

counterpart.description: The key of the unit of the other system a quantity in this unit is shown in, when the household uses that system. Absent where the quantity is shown as it is in both.
